brief: Keeps a structured, leveled log in memory that you can filter, query by field and render as text or JSON.
detail: A log is a stream of entries, each a hash-list with seq, ts (epoch milliseconds), level, category, message and fields. The levels run trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal; the threshold (info by default) drops anything below it. Write with Record or the shortcuts Info, Warn and the rest, which return the log so writes chain; read with Entries, EntriesOfLevel, Where, OfTrace and Since; render with AsText, AsJson and OtelJson, or write to a file. A cap keeps only the newest entries.
